title: Chapter 60
text:
"The Celestials are really rich. If only I could find Zero."

Mad Blade saw the Celestials' post and glanced at the reward amount with a regretful expression.

However, Mad Blade was not envious of the big guilds' opportunities at all. He looked at Han Xiao, his eyes full of passion.

"As long as I hold onto this thigh, I will definitely level faster than anyone else."

In the beginning, although his body obeyed Han Xiao's missions, his mind was very repulsed. However, he gradually found that such missions were very interesting. As long as he threw away his morals, it was much easier than killing monsters and running rings. It was simple and fun, and he gradually became addicted to it.

Mad Blade felt that his thoughts were sublimated, and he faintly understood.

Shame was a genetic constraint that hindered human development!

Pervert? No, no, no, that was a great pioneer that ordinary people could not understand! A martyr that transcended the secular world!

Lu Qian had a strange expression. She pointed at Mad Blade, who was sitting at the door and staring at Han Xiao, and said, "Is he chasing you?"

Han Xiao was speechless.

"I think he is very sincere. Why don't you just follow him?"

Lu Qian laughed mischievously. She finally got rid of the awkwardness from the previous misunderstanding and started to talk and laugh with Han Xiao again.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and reached out to tickle Lu Qian's itchy flesh. Lu Qian hurriedly dodged and screamed. She crossed her arms and held her waist, nervously staring at Han Xiao, ready to escape at any time.

Because her grandfather had the intention of matchmaking her and Han Xiao, Lu Qian was nervous for a long time. However, she gradually realized that Han Xiao's intimate actions were not because he had feelings for her, but because he did not treat her as a woman at all … or rather, he did not treat women differently. This made Lu Qian sigh in relief, but she could not help but doubt her own charm.

A woman's heart is like the bottom of the ocean. If you please her, she will be wary of you. If you don't care, she will be unhappy.

Of course, this situation is based on appearance. If you are handsome enough, please her, you can get out of the group. If you don't care, you can still get out of the group. So, it's not that I am pessimistic, but most people are destined to eat dog food or be burned to death when they are born …

Lu Qian was wearing skimpy clothes, and the white flesh on her chest was squeezed into a dangerous arc.

However, Han Xiao's heart did not waver. He was completely immune. Beauties and whatnot, he was already indifferent to them. Recently, he had been working 15 hours a day, and there seemed to be a trend towards asexuality.

Last night, he even dreamt that he had transformed his little Gougou into a machine gun. After he woke up and seriously considered the feasibility, he actually felt that it was very practical. He was so scared that he hurriedly recalled Meimei, Meimei, Meimei, Meimei, Meimei, Berry and more than a dozen of his ex-girlfriends. Only then did he reset the correct values of a male creature.

Humans can die, but birds can't.

Glancing at Mad Blade's Furious Sword, Han Xiao silently calculated the time. There was only one day left in the closed beta, and this guy was finally going to leave.

He only tested the NPC function on Mad Blade. He didn't interact with the other professional players who came to the Western Capital. There was no need for him to do so.

Suddenly, a notification appeared on the interface.

You have triggered the emergency mission [Assassination]!

Mission Tip: The assassin is about to arrive at the battlefield.

Mission Requirement: Survive.

Mission Reward: Unknown

Han Xiao's face suddenly turned solemn.

Emergency mission! An attack could happen at any time!

Damn, Old Man Lu isn't home at this time!

Feng Jun and the others were constantly monitoring the surroundings. Since he could still trigger the mission, it meant that the enemy must have used extraordinary means to approach him. It was very likely that they were Supers!

Han Xiao did not have time to explain. He rushed back to his room, took all his weapons, and strode out of the repair shop. For the sake of Old Man Lu's hidden storyline, he did not want to implicate Lu Qian.

Mad Blade's Furious Sword hurriedly followed.

Han Xiao glanced at him and did not say a word. He quickly moved, faintly alert as if someone was watching him in the dark.

If the enemy was hiding in the dark, they would be a ticking time bomb. It was better to take the initiative and let them explode.

The temperature suddenly dropped. Mad Blade's Furious Sword touched his arm and suddenly felt a little scared.

An invisible murderous intent gathered.

Han Xiao took the initiative to crawl into the dark alley. After walking for a while, his alertness suddenly rose to the highest.

His vision suddenly turned dark, as if he had fallen into a misty dark abyss. He lost all sound and had no reference at all. It was as if he was in a mother's womb. It was so quiet that he just wanted to fall asleep.

Illusion!

Han Xiao suddenly opened his eyes wide, and his energy rushed to his brain.

You have fallen into an illusion. Evaluating … Your INT is higher than 50. You are immune to this illusion.

The darkness suddenly broke, and the illusion disappeared!

The moment his senses recovered, Han Xiao found that an unfamiliar male killer had appeared five meters away from him. He raised a gun and aimed it at his forehead with a cold smile on his face.

Kata. The killer pulled the trigger.

Han Xiao's expression changed.

How could he dodge the bullet at such a close distance?

People often said that at the moment of fatal danger, time would be stretched infinitely.

Han Xiao felt that the flow of time seemed to have slowed down. The next moment, Han Xiao suppressed all negative emotions with extreme rationality, and his eyes immediately became as cold as ice.

I'm not dead yet!

The flow of time returned to normal.

The moment the bullet left the chamber, Han Xiao activated [Slide Shot], and his whole body moved horizontally for a short distance as if he had teleported!

The effect of [Slide Shot] was to move a maximum of three meters in an instant. Once the distance was reduced, the time required would also be reduced proportionally. Han Xiao had set the distance to be only five centimeters, and he dodged almost instantly, avoiding a fatal blow.

The bullet grazed the side of Han Xiao's face, ploughing out a scorched wound. The burning pain stimulated his nerves.

A sure-kill bullet had been dodged by a hair's breadth!

The killer's expression changed.

As the Germinal Organization's top assassin, Norsa had used his illusion ability to assassinate hundreds of targets. Even if the targets were also Mutants, he had never failed. According to the organization's intelligence, Zero's strength was at most at the level of an elite agent, and he only relied on machinery to fight. How could he escape from his illusion so quickly?

The intelligence was wrong!

As Han Xiao dodged with lightning speed, he pulled out the two Berserk Eagles from his waist and activated [Overload]. The large caliber bullets roared out, and the recoil caused his wrist to tremble slightly. Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang! The bullets hit Norsa, who could not dodge in time, and all of them went into Norsa's chest.

Han Xiao's use of [Slide Shot] was miraculous. It looked simple, but it was in fact a perfect explosion of his rich combat experience!

Norsa's body trembled. If not for his energy protecting his body, he would have been shot through the heart. He spat out a mouthful of blood, and his energy exploded as he tried to escape. One wrong move, and he would lose every step. He believed in the assassin's creed of running away immediately if his attack failed.

Han Xiao's face was cold. He gathered energy in his legs and caught up to Norsa. He quickly switched to a high-explosive clip, aimed at Norsa's front, and fired.

A sea of fire rose up and blocked his path. Norsa quickly stopped, gritted his teeth, and turned to look at the approaching Han Xiao. His eyes lit up with swirling colorful fog.

Detecting Illusion Intrusion. Assessing … Your INT is higher than 50. Assessment successful. You are immune to this illusion.

"Bang!"

Han Xiao's movement paused. Without saying a word, he accurately shot Norsa's neck, creating a bloody hole.

Norsa's eyes widened in horror. He covered his neck, but he could not stop the blood from splashing out. He wanted to say something, but his windpipe had been cut off. He could only make gurgling sounds.

Why was the tried and tested Illusion Arcana unable to affect Zero?

Han Xiao closed in with large strides, and his two guns were like spears. He knocked Nosa over and pressed him to the ground with both guns pointed at his chest before pulling the trigger.

"Boom!"

The gunshot was dull.

You have killed Germinal Organization Executive Officer Norsa Keno (LV25 Esper). You have received 7,500 EXP.

You have completed the Emergency Mission [Assassination]. You have received a Character Summon Card.

Han Xiao panted slightly. Blood wet his mask and flowed down his cheeks to his chin. Drops of blood fell to the ground, forming red plum blossoms.

The surroundings finally quieted down, leaving only the crackling flames.

With Norsa's death, Mad Blade's Wrath Sword broke free from the illusion. Only a moment had passed in his perception. When he saw the battle in front of him, he was shocked.
